prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: full-fidelity desktop landing-page direction comp, 1440×900 landscape, edge to edge, no browser frame or device.
Primary request: conventional premium Colombian 3D-printing storefront named “Forma 3D”; visitor immediately understands the offer and can explore products.
Real visible content: “Ideas que puedes tocar”, “Productos impresos en 3D, disponibles o fabricados bajo pedido.”, CTA “Explorar productos”, sample “$ 89.000 COP”, status “Disponible”, links “Productos”, “Personalizados”, “Cómo fabricamos”, “WhatsApp”.
Composition: execute the category standard impeccably—clear header, one persuasive hero with a large honest-looking 3D-printed product photograph, direct copy and one action; the beginning of a polished featured-products grid is visible below. It must read as a real working ecommerce page, not a poster or device mockup.
Visual law: clean white ground, dark charcoal ink, restrained royal-blue action color, professional sans serif, excellent spacing, crisp product photography.
Constraints: no gradients, no glass, no floating pill nav, no fake reviews, discounts or statistics, no lorem ipsum, no browser chrome, no mockup device.
